title: eucalyptus radiata var. australiana
intro: Eucalyptus radiata var. australiana, commonly known as Lemon-scented Gum, is a subspecies of eucalyptus native to Australia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to relieve respiratory issues, such as congestion and coughs, due to its decongestant and expectorant effects. The health benefits of Lemon-scented Gum include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help soothe sore throats, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include eucalyptol, citronellal, and limonene, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions as a decongestant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent.
